'''Holstrum Talent Agency''' was a recruitment front for the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] that operated on [[Beltrix III]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Keth Beamis]] worked as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] for the Holstrum Talent Agency.
